title: packages/index/src/pipeline holds 34 files against a budget of 30, turning the CI structure lint's dirsize stage red
evidence: Reproduction: node scripts/lint-dirsize.mjs (from the repo root at base 8520fa8). Output: 'lint-dirsize: FAIL — 1 violation(s)' / 'packages/index/src/pipeline: 34 files (budget 30)'. Two merges this week (a speaker-rules unit and the quote-verifier unit) each passed alone; the second was merged without re-running the directory check on the merged tree.
root_cause: merge without a post-merge dirsize run
fix_direction: Pure move of the unwired quote-verifier and transcript-windowing group (8 files) into pipeline/quote/; process: run lint-dirsize on the merged tree before closing out a merge.
